lesson.title: Demonstrate accuracy, resilience and cybersecurity
lesson.summary: Choose purpose-appropriate performance, fault and attack evidence.

prerequisites.reason: Metrics must be defined before meaningful tests.

blocks: **Purpose-performance metrics** measure what matters for the intended task. Article 15 requires appropriate accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity, with consistent performance through the lifecycle; accuracy levels and relevant metrics belong in the instructions.

No single percentage establishes all recruitment compliance. Explain metric choice and test context. The Commission encourages benchmarks and measurement methods; that does not create an invented universal pass number.

**Fault resilience** concerns errors, faults or inconsistencies within the system or operating environment, including interactions with people or other systems. Use technical and organisational measures; redundancy, backup or fail-safe plans can be suitable.
For Northbridge, test a broken document input or failed external service and whether the system produces a misleading rank. The examples illustrate evidence selection, not a mandatory architecture.
**AI cybersecurity** addresses unauthorised attempts to change use, outputs or performance through vulnerabilities. Measures must fit relevant circumstances and risks.

Data poisoning manipulates training data; model poisoning targets pretrained components; adversarial inputs or evasion seek mistaken outputs. Confidentiality attacks target protected information. Where appropriate, measures must prevent, detect, respond, resolve and control these attacks or model flaws.

Keep performance, fault and attack evidence distinct. A clean network scan does not prove resistance to misleading input or corrupted training labels. A good aggregate accuracy result does not establish safe fallback.
Case: Northbridge changes an external dependency. Review whether the previous test conditions and resilience/security evidence remain appropriate to the actual version and context.

options.blocks: Appropriate metrics, context and separate requirement evidence
